messages:
sara_fin: Heads-up: Kestrel Labs payment for INV-2029-078 ($42,300.00) returned (ACH R03) on 2024-03-18. AP says PO mismatch. We sent a soft dunning yesterday. Need guidance: automated retries, manual pay link, short payment plan, or escalate.

billing-bot: Soft dunning email delivered to billing@kestrel.com at 2230012347. Next automated ACH retry scheduled in 48h.

eli_sales: Sales update: AE says Kestrel will wire but their AP requires a PO. They asked for a signed addendum to permit split payment. Can we offer 50/50 with a signed addendum?

tom_ops: I can queue two more ACH retries (48h apart) and generate a one-time pay link. Command I used in staging for reference:
```
# create pay link
/billing create-link INV-2029-078 amount=42300 expire_days=7
```

sara_fin: Do the retries and create the pay link with 7-day expiry. If unpaid after 7 days, add 10% late fee and escalate. Need legal ok on timeline.

maria_legal: Contract SOW '4.2' requires a 30-day cure notice before external collections. Recommend we: 1) send formal notice quoting SOW excerpt cc:legal, 2) wait 14 days for internal escalation, 3) only proceed to 3rd-party after SOW window. Also: if they raise a usage dispute, don't withhold undisputed amounts.

michelle_csr: Drafting formal notice now. Will include invoice PDF, ledger export, pay link, and wire instructions. Will post copy once sent.

eli_sales: If they sign an addendum for 50/50 split and pay first installment, sales will keep access active and handle their procurement follow-up.

sara_fin: Plan: (1) queue 2 ACH retries, (2) create/send pay link, (3) send formal notice cc:legal, (4) escalate to collections after 14 days post-notice if unpaid. Michelle please attach invoice & ledger.

billing-bot: Payment link created: https://pay.redwood.example/lnk/xyz789 (expires in 7 days).

michelle_csr: Formal notice sent at 2230013200 to billing@kestrel.com; subject: "Formal Notice: Past Due INV-2029-078 per SOW 4.2". Included SOW excerpt and payment options. Excerpt: "Per SOW 4.2, customer shall cure payment within thirty (30) days of invoice receipt. Failure to cure may result in interest and collections."

sara_fin: Logged ticket ESCALATE-INV-2029-078. I'll check back at 2230013800 to decide next step. :thumbsup:
